name: TPC-1 typed premise certificate schema

OWN_REPO_IDENTITY.admission: authorized role-local path resolved on frozen/current allowed repository state to exact Git blob SHA
OWN_REPO_IDENTITY.immutable_anchor: path + exact blob SHA (and commit/ref identity when needed)
OWN_REPO_IDENTITY.scope: repository object identity; readable text semantics only through explicit parser

PROVIDER_VERIFIED_COMMIT_FILE.admission: exact commit SHA; GitHub verification.verified=true and reason=valid; file resolved at same exact commit
PROVIDER_VERIFIED_COMMIT_FILE.scope: GitHub-provider-asserted signed commit/source-state identity plus explicit parsed file semantics

PROVIDER_VERIFIED_ANNOTATED_TAG_FILE.admission: tag ref resolves to exact annotated tag object; tag verification.verified=true/reason=valid; exact target object; file resolved at exact target
PROVIDER_VERIFIED_ANNOTATED_TAG_FILE.immutable_anchor: tag-object SHA + target SHA + file blob SHA
PROVIDER_VERIFIED_ANNOTATED_TAG_FILE.scope: GitHub-provider-asserted signed tag/release-intent identity, target identity and explicit parsed file semantics

LIGHTWEIGHT_TAG_TO_VERIFIED_COMMIT.admission: tag ref type=commit; exact target commit separately has verified=true/reason=valid
LIGHTWEIGHT_TAG_TO_VERIFIED_COMMIT.immutable_anchor: target commit SHA; tag name not treated as signed object
LIGHTWEIGHT_TAG_TO_VERIFIED_COMMIT.scope: source-state identity only under commit-origin semantics

DERIVED.admission: all parent certificates admitted and local derivation rule checks
DERIVED.scope: conjunction of all parent scopes, never broader

EXTERNAL_OBSERVATION.admission: REJECT by default; requires a separate independently admitted observation certificate

RAW_SIGNATURE.admission: REJECT by default; bytes without exposed verifier result are not authenticity

composition_rules: No origin automatically upgrades to a stronger origin.
Failure of a signed-tag admission may fall back to commit-origin only after separately checking the exact target commit verification; the fallback scope is commit-only.
DERIVED scope is the intersection/conjunction of parent scopes plus the local parser/rule scope.
A semantic parser may only claim properties of admitted readable content; it cannot infer environment/runtime facts not present in content.
Mutable branch/release names are discovery pointers, never final immutable anchors.
Every rejected or absent premise fails closed; no default environment, default digest or guessed verifier state.
schema.decision_precedence: Not a numeric trust ranking. First classify the concrete evidence object by structure (own path, exact commit, annotated tag, lightweight tag, declaration, raw observation); then apply only its matching admission rule. A failed specific origin can use another origin only if that other origin is independently evidenced.

TPC1_typed_certificate_layer.success_probability: high when all premises are readable identities/declarations; low for opaque runtime facts
TPC1_typed_certificate_layer.conflict_risk: low due exact immutable anchors and fail-closed origins
TPC1_typed_certificate_layer.integration_cost: low-medium; small schema and local rules

outcomes_addressed: strong arbitrary computation verification in supported model

result.revision: The recurring-Chat replacement pattern is now explicit: admit only typed immutable/readable premises, apply finite local checkers, carry trust scope through every derivation and leave opaque measurement/execution as unresolved rather than smuggling it in as configuration or signature text.
result.scope: tested evidence-origin classifications and bounded finite derivations only

frontier: Build an outcome-boundary table for common build/test tasks: metadata query, deterministic config selection, dependency identity, parser/linter subset, compilation, linking, unit test with pure finite model, filesystem/network test, performance test; state certificate replacement condition and counterexample.

Probe repository-native commit/check status metadata as preexisting evidence but reject any generation path requiring hosted CI; distinguish read-only already-present status from fresh status production.
Test TPC-1 reconstruction from a compact checkpoint in a later invocation to ensure the schema actually supports stateless continuation without hidden context.
